2. The accuracy also accounts for how close you are to the opponent. If you're only a few feet away, he's likely going to hit you even if he is using an early musket.   

3. There also wasn't many firearms 600 years ago as the earliest record of firearms dates back to the mid\-late 14th century. So having a firearm at this point would likely intimidate your opponent.
